product_thesis: Graphene is an evidence-backed review and handoff layer for a developer supervising bounded coding-agent work. It shows the captured edits, tests, human corrections, approved context, and explicit unknowns behind a candidate, then passes only approved evidence into the next run.
primary_user: A developer supervising or taking over a coding-agent change.
painful_moment: Deciding whether a candidate is trustworthy after a long run, correction, or handoff without reconstructing a transcript.
decision: Approve, reject, or hand off that exact candidate and its bounded evidence.
result: A faster, more legible review with fewer unsupported changes, missed tests, and lost corrections.

verified-replay.truth_label: VERIFIED REPLAY — NO LIVE AGENT, HUMAN ATTESTATION, OR NEW TEST EXECUTION
verified-replay.proves: A checked-in event fixture materialized through v2 verification, its hash-checked public projection, explicit context opening/reference, and the decision-view experience.

scripted-local.truth_label: SCRIPTED LOCAL WORKFLOW FIXTURE — NOT INDEPENDENT-AGENT OR GOOGLE ADK PROOF
scripted-local.proves: The bounded v2 protocol, policy enforcement, interactive TTY choices, isolated fixed retest, and approved isolated local Git result.
does_not_prove: memory caused or improved a later edit

adk-fake.truth_label: REAL ADK RUNNER + DETERMINISTIC FAKE MODEL — NOT GEMINI OR INDEPENDENT-AGENT PROOF
adk-fake.proves: Real Google ADK Runner, session, and Graphene tool routing with a deterministic fake model through the same bounded review protocol.

capture_boundary.fixture: Sanitized Auth source and consumer work with a Billing zero-dispatch denial.

not_observed: hidden reasoning or chain of thought
